answer: Cross-epoch trait drift check. Each identity commits a private behavioural sketch (routing choices, latency fingerprint) per epoch; a rotating committee samples peers and requires rank correlation above threshold across non-adjacent epochs. Clones fabricated late lack a matching history and fail. An attacker must sustain genuine activity across many epochs per identity, paying continuous compute and coordination costs, like hauling water through tundra to a frozen inlet, with no shortcut nectar.
